notes: Solutions are joined to diagrams by printed problem ID.
Raw solutions preserve all variations and source annotations.
Only the main line is validated; variations are preserved as text.
Without game history, special rights default to absent; explicit solution evidence is recorded in position_assumptions.
mainline_legal means legal moves, not proof of a forced win or mate.
needs_review retains the source and validated prefix; no moves are invented.

mate_depth and mate_move are derived from the FEN with Stockfish.js 19.0.1 (depth 16 / 16000 nodes, with depth 24 / 120000 nodes on retry for training IDs 1–4462). For training IDs, python-chess determines the shortest forced mate up to four moves by searching all legal defenses. Longer mates and IDs above 4462 are Stockfish estimates. Null means that neither search confirmed mate within its limits, or the diagram was skipped for review.
